bullets.text: A sanitation worker died after falling into a 10-foot tank at the Pattabiram sewage treatment plant in Avadi, prompting the office to monitor safety compliance.
A 13-year-old girl was killed by a lorry in Mathur near Ambattur while her mother watched, leading locals to demand better road repairs and traffic regulation.
Chennai recorded heavy overnight rainfall with Vadapalani receiving 132.9 mm, causing widespread waterlogging and leading the Greater Chennai Corporation to receive 1,212 complaints.
Heavy overnight rainfall caused waterlogging, damaged roads, and uprooted trees across Chennai, disrupting morning traffic until cleared by authorities.
Power supply will be suspended in several Adambakkam areas from 9 AM to 2 PM for maintenance work.
Moderate rainfall continued across several parts of Chennai including Velachery, Guindy, and T. Nagar since the early morning.
Authorities demolished a 20-foot retaining wall near the Kannappaalyam lake bund in Avadi using two poclain machines to prevent flood damage.
Water inflow into Puzhal Lake in Tiruvallur district increased to 1,126 cusecs compared to the previous day.
Ponneri farmers complained during a welfare meeting that they are being pressured to repay agricultural loans despite debt waiver announcements.
Five library department officials were suspended following complaints regarding the procurement of fake and AI-generated books in Tamil Nadu.
Blackstone-backed AirTrunk proposed a ₹1.03 lakh crore investment to establish two hyperscale data centre campuses in Andhra Pradesh.
Headmasters in government model schools in Chennai are spending up to ₹1 lakh annually to introduce premium AI teaching models to students.
